objective: Six new ranch upgrades in the rules (decision 0072): the Hatchery (eggs hatching at once), the Egg Cellar (eggs stored), the Brooder (hatching speed), the Windmill (coins an hour, also while away), the Trophy Lodge (coins from waves) and the Titan's Den (the Titan's stats in a wave), with draft levels and prices.

A new ranch has three nests and room for eight stored eggs; a save from before keeps every egg it holds
The Windmill pays whole coins by the hour, for at most eight hours of time away
The Titan's boost is never stored on the animal
